ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels centrally located and 35% low-intensity black pixels localized at margins and the median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white blobs occupy the interior regions of both lobes. Dense black pigmentation forms a continuous boundary along the trailing edge and becomes mottled near the fluke base. Distinct small circular black spots are visible in the upper mid-section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 72 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 15% of the visible vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys are concentrated at the distal tips, creating a jagged silhouette.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep curving upwards from the median notch, with a slight transition to concavity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast yellowish-white clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, showing localized structural surface accretion.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear disruptions. Left lobe exhibits three distinct vertical parallel rake marks and a circular mark. Right lobe displays several thin, curved diagonal scratches cutting into the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible rake marks (parallel scarring) on both lobes; significant irregular edge topography and suspected parasitic or barnacle clusters at the lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive concentric black ring with a central focal point (bullseye pattern) located in the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe's interior.
